validation_implementation: Local contract checks were executed against the field shapes and sufficiency invariants used by current synchronized project ATOM artifacts; source anchors and semantic coverage were additionally reviewed against the supplied main article and Supplement 1.

extraction_limitations: The source is observational; extracted associations should not be interpreted as causal effects.
Supplement 2 (Data Sharing Statement) was referenced by the main article but was not supplied.
Main Figure 2 contains bar graphs for absolute mortality percentages without printed numeric labels; exact bar heights were not reconstructed from graphics.
All atoms remain review_status=needs_review; automated structural/sufficiency checks do not replace independent human verification.
